protocol.previous_turn: String publication V1 rejected and pushed as 65220b0; regression diagnosis pushed as 574c620. V1 original deadline remains missed. No accepted production change since string views.
protocol.specific: Retain V1 coallocated string storage and D055 preflight/borrow guarantees. Share budget/slot preparation and installation inside the publication owner, avoiding external prepare/commit validation and transaction overhead for already allocated objects. Check the last successful exact array-cache entry first in D104 OFF hot regions, preserving full identity/layout validation, capacity, replacement order, lifetime and exact fuel.
protocol.evidence: V1 Native record-create regressed 6.83%/6.20%; isolated legacy wrapper lowers medians 7.06%/6.35%, with 132096 record publications and no GC. OFF Dijkstra P90 regressed 20.28%/20.86% with extra user CPU and byte-identical hot-owner objects. Exact before/candidate counters agree:151722696 array lookups and346654087 probes; previous-entry-first trace predicts227999334 probes (-34.23%), unchanged counts for title100k and heap-sort. Layout effects remain possible; no diagnosis accepts V1.
protocol.early_gate: Original title pair, 3 warmups plus 11 rotating/alternating fresh-process pairs. Native pair geometric latency reduction >=10%, each Native row >=5%; ON pair geometric reduction >=3%, neither ON row median/P90 >5% slower. Targets (not minima): Native pair >=20%, ON pair >=10%. Failed minima reject the candidate before full validation/timing.
protocol.full_gate: All32 correctness and independent Native/ON/OFF paired timing with 3+11 observations. Native summed medians improve >=3%; ON and OFF sums may not regress >1%. Any per-row median or P90 regression >5% gets exactly one confirmation; a repeated same-metric excess rejects. Preserve all observations and prior rejected experiments; fresh unchanged five-way comparison required after acceptance.
protocol.validation: Focused GC/publication/string tests; every material success/failure path and reachable deterministic allocation index, both zero ledgers, heap budget precedence without allocator calls, exact boundary/slot growth/reuse/retirement, rooted and unrooted borrowed byte slices, aliased output, embedded NUL/empty/Unicode, GC errors and pending-state cleanup. Full ON/OFF CTest, all32 outputs, focused ASan/UBSan and x86 Rosetta, architecture/memory/docs/generated gates. LinuxLSan/fullTier1 remain explicit open gates. D104 last-entry path must retain cold/program differential results, every finite/shared fuel boundary, cache eviction/rebinding, equal-metadata distinct references, wrong layouts and aliases; no new allocation API is introduced by the cache order. Full Rosetta Native selection retains its original timeout.
protocol.host_gate: No builds/tests/profiles during acceptance timing; three quiet snapshots 10s apart, process monitoring every5s, reject known foreign compute >=40% CPU and monitor gaps >15s. Frozen control/compiler/native/runtime/source identities.
protocol.limits: Original arguments, outputs, algorithms and 64MiB heap; logical header/payload/slot byte charges unchanged. D055 budget-over-host precedence is corrected to the accepted normative contract, not weakened.
protocol.regression_early_gate: In addition to the unchanged title-pair early gate, 3+11 paired Native record-create must have median and P90 ratios <=1.03; OFF Dijkstra must improve its median by >=2% and have P90 ratio <=1.00. These new early guards are required before full validation/timing; no favorable retry of a failed guard. Full all32 thresholds remain unchanged.
protocol.storage_recovery: Filesystem exhausted during diagnosis. Thirteen completed historical sanitizer build caches were removed after archiving logs/metadata; current controls/candidate284 files and all46 Rosetta binary hashes remain verified. Raw original diagnostic JSON was removed only after matching its exact bytes to the committed evidence archive. APFS clones preserve current test copies and independent writes.
